missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Погода' stays in the nominative case as the feminine subject. 'Хорошая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Погоду' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'. 'Тёплую летнюю' are the agreeing feminine accusative adjectives.

missions.phrase: Из-за плохой погоды мы остались дома.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of cause. 'Погоды' is the genitive form after 'из-за' to express the reason. 'Плохой' agrees in the feminine genitive. A core cause pattern.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим о погоде каждый день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О погоде' uses the prepositional form 'погоде' after 'о' to express talking about the weather. The classic small-talk topic.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Погоде' is the dative form after 'благодаря', which governs the dative to express favourable cause.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Погодой' is the instrumental case required by 'наслаждаться'. 'Прекрасной' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional with условие. 'Погоде' uses the prepositional form after 'при' to mean 'in such weather'. 'Такой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.

missions.phrase: В горах часто бывают плохие погоды.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Погоды' is the nominative plural subject describing recurring weather conditions. 'Плохие' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Погод' is the genitive plural after 'нет' to express absence. 'Хороших' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with instrumental predicate. 'Погода' is the nominative subject, while 'тёплой' takes the instrumental as a predicate after 'будет'. A useful future-tense model.
